outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with fetal growth restriction (FGR) delivered at or after 34 weeks gestation
finding: In this cohort of FGR pregnancies delivered at or after 34 weeks gestation, spontaneous labor and labor induction were associated with higher odds of neonatal morbidity compared to elective cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Spontaneous labor and labor induction had higher odds of neonatal morbidity compared to elective cesarean delivery.
